CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：CONFIDENTIAL）
File No. ... L. POLICE
S. C. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. ...
Date January 4, 1939
Subject Communication dated 2... from the Netherlands Consulate-General
concerning Miss L. Matusiak.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford. S. I.

It would appear from enquiries that Miss Leokadja
MATUSIAK is identical with one Miss Leokadia Kazimirovna Ma-
tusiak, who is reported to have arrived in Shanghai from Dairen
in January, 1931 and during the summer of the same year was em-
ployed as a dancing partner in the Savoy Hotel Ball Room. She
resided at 38 Carter Road until 16-3-31, after which she re-
moved to 630 Avenue Joffre. Later she is known to have resided
at 632 Route Vallon and 115 Route Vallon for various periods,
and from December, 1935 to April, 1937 - at 149 Yuen Ming Yuen
Road, Apt. 53. From the latter address she removed to 28 Route
Winling.

It appears that she worked in the above capacity un-
til about 1935, after which no information is available as to
the nature of her occupation. It is reported that she is on
friendly terms with Mr. H.L. Wilson mentioned in the communi-
cation in question.

On 26-5-38 she left for the Netherlands Indies in
the m.v. "Tjinegara," from which trip she returned on 7-8-38 in
the s.s. "Empress of Asia." From December 1, 1938 to the date
of her departure for Singapore ( 22-12-38) in the m.v. "Tjinega-
ra" she stayed at the Broadway Mansions.

No additional information is available at the local
Polish Consulate-General regarding the lady, except that she was
registered on the strength of a Polish passport issued at Har-
bin.

While in Shanghai Miss Matusiak did not come to the
notice of the Municipal Police in connection with any activities
of an undesirable character.

D.B.R.
P.A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)
D. C. ( Special Branch)

G. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

编号 S. B. D. ...
日期 1939年1月4日
事由：关于荷兰总领事馆就L. Matusiak女士一事于2...日发出的公函。
由警探长普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）撰写。由高级警探克劳福德（C. Crawford）转呈。

经查询，Leokadja MATUSIAK女士似与Leokadia Kazimirovna Matusiak女士为同一人。据报，后者于1931年1月从大连抵达上海，并于同年夏季在沙逊大厦（Savoy Hotel）舞厅受雇为舞伴。她居住于卡特路（Carter Road）38号，直至1931年3月16日，随后迁至霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）630号。此后已知她曾断续居住于华伦路（Route Vallon）632号及115号，并于1935年12月至1937年4月期间居住在圆明园路149号53室。之后她从该地址迁至林森路（Route Winling）28号。

据悉，她从事上述职业直至约1935年，此后关于其职业性质的信息暂无可查。据报，她与前述公函中提及的H.L. Wilson先生关系友好。

1938年5月26日，她乘坐“芝尼加拉”号（m.v. "Tjinegara"）轮船前往荷属东印度，并于1938年8月7日乘坐“亚细亚皇后”号（s.s. "Empress of Asia"）轮船返回。从1938年12月1日至她于1938年12月22日乘坐“芝尼加拉”号轮船前往新加坡之日止，她一直住在百老汇大厦（Broadway Mansions）。

波兰驻上海总领事馆当地办事处除告知该女士持有一本在哈尔滨签发的波兰护照进行登记外，没有关于她的其他补充信息。

Matusiak女士在上海期间，并未因任何不良行为引起工部局警务处的注意。

D.B.R.
副总监助理（特别支部）
副总监（特别支部）

G. Prokofiev
警探长

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No.3656.
SHANGHAI, 21st December 1938.
Confidential
S. D. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 8919
Date 23 / 12

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Miss Leokadja Matusiak,
applied to this Consulate General in May last for a visé for ad-
mission into the Netherlands Indies.

Miss Matusiak was in possession of a Polish passport Series
No.414095 No.26/35 issued by the Polish Legation at Shanghai on
February 5th 1935 and extended until February 5, 1939.

According to her passport she was born at Lodz in August 11th
1897, her profession was stated to be beauty expert.

She was introduced to this Consulate General by Mr.H.L.Wilson,
a British subject, Director of the Electric & Musical Industries
(China) Ltd., 1099 Route de Zikawei, who is an acquaintance of one
of the members of the staff of this Consulate.

Mr. Wilson has been travelling continually to Singapore, Sai-
gon and the Netherlands Indies during the last year for his company.

A visé was granted to applicant on May 5th 1938. At that time
she stated to be residing at 28 Route Winling.

Miss Matusiak intends to leave for the Netherlands Indies again
on December 22nd 1938 on board of the m.v. "Tjinegara".

As her former visé was only valid for one trip to the Nether-
lands Indies she applied for a new visé.

According to information received from the local office of the
Java China Japan Line, the roundtrip passage for Miss Matusiak has
been ordered by telegram from Singapore, where I understand Mr.
Wilson is staying at the moment.

From the passport of the lady it appears furthermore that she
she been travelling in Europe in 1936, where she visited various
countries.

The Deputy Commissioner
Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

She

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号：HOLLANDIA

第3656号。
上海，1938年12月21日。
机密
S. D. 登记处
编号 S. B. D. 8919
日期 23 / 12

先生：

谨此告知，Leokadja Matusiak女士于去年五月向本总领事馆申请进入荷属东印度的签证。

Matusiak女士持有波兰护照，系列号414095，编号26/35，由波兰驻上海公使馆于1935年2月5日签发，有效期延至1939年2月5日。

根据其护照记载，她于1897年8月11日出生于罗兹（Lodz），职业申报为美容专家。

她由英国臣民H.L. Wilson先生引荐至本总领事馆。Wilson先生系徐家汇路1099号电气与音乐工业（中国）有限公司（Electric & Musical Industries (China) Ltd.）董事，与本总领事馆一名职员相识。

过去一年中，Wilson先生代表其公司频繁往返于新加坡、西贡及荷属东印度之间。

申请人于1938年5月5日获发签证。当时她声称居住于林森路（Route Winling）28号。

Matusiak女士拟于1938年12月22日再次乘坐“芝尼加拉”号轮船前往荷属东印度。

由于其前次签证仅适用于单次前往荷属东印度的行程，故她申请了新签证。

根据从爪哇-中国-日本轮船公司（Java China Japan Line）当地办事处获得的信息，Matusiak女士的往返船票已由新加坡通过电报预订，据我了解，Wilson先生目前正逗留于新加坡。

此外，从该女士的护照可以看出，她曾于1936年在欧洲旅行，访问了多个国家。

致：
上海工部局警务处
特别支部副总监
上海

她
（签名）
副总监助理（特别支部）
（签名）
D.S.S. Badhukin
